rationale: The most recent 5-minute candle printed a low of $9.06, which directly breached the original invalidation level of $9.10 — the structural basis for the trade is mechanically invalidated regardless of the close being back above it. With today's realized loss already at -$271.68 against a $1,000 daily budget and no new catalyst, preserving remaining risk budget outweighs holding a position whose key level was violated.
